summary: MRTR (SEP-2322) is the only sanctioned way in 2026-07-28 for a server to obtain client input (elicitation/create, sampling/createMessage, roots/list). Servers no longer send JSON-RPC requests to clients; that is a breaking change (mrtr.md Note L9-16; stdio.md L57; streamable-http.md L114). Instead, a server answers a supported client request (only tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get; mrtr.md "Supported Requests") with a JSON-RPC success response whose result is an InputRequiredResult: {resultType:"input_required", inputRequests?: map<key, ElicitRequest|CreateMessageRequest|ListRootsRequest>, requestState?: string}. At least one of inputRequests/requestState MUST be present (mrtr.md Server Req 6; schema.ts L575). The client fulfills every inputRequest, then re-issues the ORIGINAL request as a NEW JSON-RPC request (different id) whose params additionally carry inputResponses (same keys, values ElicitResult|CreateMessageResult|ListRootsResult) and, only if the server supplied it, the byte-exact requestState (Client Req 1-4). requestState is opaque to the client and attacker-controlled to the server: servers MUST integrity-protect it (HMAC/AEAD) when it affects authz/resource access/business logic and MUST reject failed verification; SHOULD bind principal, TTL and originating-request digest; single-use MUST be enforced server-side (Server Req 4-5, Security Considerations). Servers MUST NOT embed a request type the client did not declare in _meta clientCapabilities (Server Req 7) and MUST NOT assume the client retries (Server Req 8). Load shedding = requestState-only InputRequiredResult (schema.ts L579), which the client MAY retry immediately. Missing/partial inputResponses SHOULD yield another InputRequiredResult, not an error; unknown extra inputResponses SHOULD be ignored; malformed data SHOULD be a JSON-RPC error. Interim input_required results and MRTR retry results MUST NOT be cached (caching.md L25-39). No round or size limits are specified.

methods.name: tools/call (MRTR-capable; may return InputRequiredResult)
methods.params: CallToolRequestParams extends InputResponseRequestParams: _meta: RequestMetaObject (REQUIRED, must carry io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities; SHOULD carry io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo), name: string (REQUIRED), arguments?: {[k:string]: unknown}, inputResponses?: InputResponses (map key -> ElicitResult | CreateMessageResult | ListRootsResult), requestState?: string (schema.ts L600-609, L1863-1872; schema.json required: [_meta, name]).
methods.result: CallToolResultResponse.result = CallToolResult | InputRequiredResult (schema.ts L1848-1850; schema.json anyOf). CallToolResult: resultType (REQUIRED, "complete"), content: ContentBlock[] (REQUIRED), structuredContent?: unknown, isError?: boolean, _meta?. InputRequiredResult: resultType "input_required" (REQUIRED), inputRequests?: InputRequests, requestState?: string, _meta?; at least one of inputRequests/requestState MUST be present. Not CacheableResult; no ttlMs/cacheScope.
methods.capability_gate: Server must advertise `tools` server capability for tools/call at all (server__tools.md). For the embedded requests the SERVER is gated by the CLIENT's declared capabilities in _meta io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities: elicitation (with form/url sub-modes), sampling (deprecated SEP-2577), roots (deprecated SEP-2577) (mrtr.md Server Req 7; schema.ts ClientCapabilities L716-786).
methods.notes: Retry is a brand-new JSON-RPC request with a new id, same method, same original params plus inputResponses/requestState (mrtr.md Client Req 3; basic__patterns__index.md L58 'original params + inputResponses'). On Streamable HTTP the retry is a separate POST with its own Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers (streamable-http.md L195-213). server__tools.md L174-232 shows a worked example with requestState 'eyJsb2NhdGlvbiI6Ik5ldyBZb3JrIn0...'.

methods.name: resources/read (MRTR-capable; may return InputRequiredResult)
methods.params: ReadResourceRequestParams extends ResourceRequestParams, InputResponseRequestParams: _meta (REQUIRED), uri: string (REQUIRED, format uri), inputResponses?: InputResponses, requestState?: string (schema.ts L1205-1206; schema.json required: [_meta, uri]).
methods.result: ReadResourceResultResponse.result = ReadResourceResult | InputRequiredResult (schema.ts L1244-1246). ReadResourceResult extends CacheableResult: resultType, contents: (TextResourceContents|BlobResourceContents)[] (REQUIRED), ttlMs: number (REQUIRED, >=0), cacheScope (REQUIRED). InputRequiredResult as above and is explicitly NOT cacheable and carries no caching hints (caching.md L25-27).
methods.capability_gate: Server `resources` capability for the method; client capabilities gate embedded inputRequests (Server Req 7).
methods.notes: server__resources.md L179: Servers MAY respond with InputRequiredResult; clients include inputResponses and, if provided, requestState on retry. caching.md L36-39: results produced by a request carrying inputResponses or requestState MUST NOT be cached.

methods.name: prompts/get (MRTR-capable; may return InputRequiredResult)
methods.params: GetPromptRequestParams extends InputResponseRequestParams: _meta (REQUIRED), name: string (REQUIRED), arguments?: {[k:string]: string}, inputResponses?: InputResponses, requestState?: string (schema.ts L1602-1611; schema.json required: [_meta, name]).
methods.result: GetPromptResultResponse.result = GetPromptResult | InputRequiredResult (schema.ts L1650-1652). GetPromptResult: resultType, description?: string, messages: PromptMessage[] (REQUIRED).
methods.capability_gate: Server `prompts` capability for the method; client capabilities gate embedded inputRequests.
methods.notes: server__prompts.md L167: Servers MAY also respond to prompts/get with an InputRequiredResult.

methods.name: InputRequiredResult (result variant, resultType = "input_required")
methods.params: n/a (it is a Result). Fields: resultType: "input_required" (REQUIRED for 2026-07-28 servers), inputRequests?: InputRequests = {[key: string]: ElicitRequest | CreateMessageRequest | ListRootsRequest}, requestState?: string (opaque; e.g. base64 JSON, encrypted JWT, serialized binary), _meta?: ResultMetaObject (SHOULD contain io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo per basic index). Keys of inputRequests are server-assigned and MUST be unique within the request. schema.json only enforces required:[resultType]; the 'at least one of inputRequests/requestState' rule is prose (mrtr.md Server Req 6; schema.ts L575) and must be enforced in SDK code.
methods.capability_gate: Servers MUST NOT send it on any client request other than prompts/get, resources/read, tools/call (mrtr.md 'Supported Requests'). Embedded request types gated by client capabilities.
methods.notes: Included in ServerResult union (schema.ts L3197). ResultType = "complete" | "input_required" | string; extensions MAY add values but only those advertised via capabilities; unrecognized values MUST be treated as invalid by the client; absent resultType from older servers MUST be treated as "complete" (basic__index.md L81-87; schema.ts L229-232).

methods.name: elicitation/create (embedded in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests)
methods.params: ElicitRequest = {method: "elicitation/create", params: ElicitRequestParams = ElicitRequestFormParams | ElicitRequestURLParams} (schema.ts L2856-2859, L2845). No jsonrpc, no id. Form mode: mode: "form" or omitted, message (REQUIRED), requestedSchema (REQUIRED). URL mode: mode: "url", message, url (REQUIRED, valid URL); NO elicitationId in this revision (changelog item 11).
methods.result: Client places ElicitResult under the same key in inputResponses: {action: "accept"|"decline"|"cancel" (REQUIRED), content?: {[k]: string|number|boolean|string[]} (only when action accept and mode form; omitted for URL mode)} (schema.ts L3134-3149).
methods.capability_gate: Client must declare `elicitation` capability (with `form` and/or `url`; at least one mode MUST be supported); servers MUST NOT send elicitation requests with modes the client does not support (elicitation.md L51, L79-81) and MUST NOT include elicitation/create at all if the client lacks the capability (mrtr.md Server Req 7).
methods.notes: URL mode under MRTR: accept means consent only; the out-of-band interaction completes later; on retry the server decides from echoed requestState (or its own stored state) whether it is complete and returns either the final result or another InputRequiredResult; clients SHOULD provide manual retry/cancel controls (elicitation.md L374-381, L405-429). Servers MUST handle decline/cancel/client failure (elicitation.md L589). Servers needing to correlate an elicitation across retries encode their own identifier in requestState (changelog item 11).

methods.name: sampling/createMessage (embedded in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests)
methods.params: CreateMessageRequest = {method: "sampling/createMessage", params: CreateMessageRequestParams} (schema.ts L2185-2188, L2104). CreateMessageRequestParams does NOT extend RequestParams, so no _meta is required inside the embedded request. Fields include messages (REQUIRED), modelPreferences?, systemPrompt?, maxTokens, tools?, toolChoice?, includeContext? (see sampling extraction).
methods.result: Client places CreateMessageResult under the same key: extends SamplingMessage {role, content} plus model: string (REQUIRED), stopReason?: "endTurn"|"stopSequence"|"maxTokens"|"toolUse"|string (schema.ts L2210-2224).
methods.capability_gate: Client must declare `sampling` capability (deprecated as of 2026-07-28, SEP-2577, retained >= 12 months); sub-caps `tools`, `context` gate tool-use / includeContext usage (schema.ts L733-759).
methods.notes: Multi-turn agentic sampling is realised as successive InputRequiredResults, each retry carrying the previous CreateMessageResult (sampling.md L170-200, L284-287). If the user declines or an error occurs the client does not need to replay the original call with an error, since the server is not waiting (sampling.md L667-668).

methods.name: roots/list (embedded in InputRequiredResult.inputRequests)
methods.result: Client places ListRootsResult under the same key: {roots: Root[]} where Root.uri MUST be a file:// URI (roots.md L102; schema.ts L2742-2744).
methods.capability_gate: Client must declare `roots` capability (deprecated SEP-2577; new implementations SHOULD NOT adopt it, roots.md L15-16). Servers SHOULD check for roots capability before usage (roots.md L159).
methods.notes: notifications/roots/list_changed removed in 2026-07-28 (changelog item 5). roots.md L134-135: on error the client need not replay with an error message.

methods.name: MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError (related error, not MRTR-specific)
methods.result: JSON-RPC error code -32021, data.requiredCapabilities: ClientCapabilities (REQUIRED); HTTP status MUST be 400 Bad Request (schema.json; basic__index.md L390-394).
methods.notes: This is the sanctioned response when a server would need an inputRequest type the client did not declare; MRTR itself forbids sending such inputRequests (Server Req 7). Example in schema is 'missing elicitation capability'.

requirements.text: Send server-to-client requests (roots/list, sampling/createMessage, elicitation/create) using the MRTR pattern; the previous pattern of server-initiated JSON-RPC requests is no longer supported (breaking change).
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Note L9-16; stdio.md L57-60; streamable-http.md L114-121

requirements.text: Include the required _meta fields (io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo, io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities) on every request, including MRTR retries (examples on the page omit them for brevity only).
Inspect, parse, modify, or make any assumptions about the contents of requestState.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md InputRequiredResult L132; Client Req 2 L261-262

requirements.text: Respond with InputRequiredResult on prompts/get, resources/read, tools/call.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Supported Requests L186-192; Server Req 1 L228

requirements.text: Send InputRequiredResult on any client request other than prompts/get, resources/read, tools/call.
inputRequests keys are server-assigned identifiers and MUST be unique within the scope of the request.
inputRequests values MUST be one of ElicitRequest, CreateMessageRequest, or ListRootsRequest.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 2 L232; schema.ts L537-538

requirements.text: Include a requestState field; if specified it is an opaque string meaningful only to the server, encodable in any format (base64 JSON, encrypted JWT, serialized binary).
Treat a requestState present in a client request as attacker-controlled input.
If requestState influences authorization, resource access, or business logic, protect its integrity (e.g. HMAC or AEAD) and reject state that fails verification.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 4 L236-237; Security Considerations L278-279

requirements.text: Omit integrity protection only when tampering can cause nothing worse than request failure.

To prevent replay, include inside the integrity-protected requestState and verify on receipt: the authenticated principal (reject other principals), a short expiry TTL (reject after lapse), and an identifier of the originating request (method name + digest of salient params; reject on mismatch).
Servers for which a given requestState must be consumed at most once (e.g. one-time redemptions) MUST enforce that invariant server-side; the replay measures above do not guarantee single use.
Include at least one of inputRequests or requestState in every InputRequiredResult.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 6 L250; schema.ts L575

requirements.text: Send an inputRequest the client has not declared support for in its capabilities (e.g. no elicitation/create if the client did not declare elicitation).
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 7 L252; elicitation.md L81 (modes)

requirements.text: Assume that clients will fulfill the inputRequests or retry the original request.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Server Req 8 L254; elicitation.md L589

requirements.text: Return an InputRequiredResult on multiple successive attempts of the same request to repeatedly prompt until it has what it needs.
If an InputRequiredResult contains inputRequests, construct all requested inputs before retrying the original request.
If an InputRequiredResult does not contain inputRequests (requestState-only / load shedding), retry the original request immediately.
requirements.cite: mrtr.md Client Req 1 L259-260; schema.ts L579-580

requirements.text: If an InputRequiredResult contains requestState, echo back the exact value of that field when retrying the original request.
Include a requestState in the retry if the InputRequiredResult did not contain one.
Use a different JSON-RPC id for the retry than for the initial request; they are independent requests.
Use inputRequests or requestState for any request other than the retry of the original request (never for parallel requests).
For each key in the response's inputRequests, the same key must appear in inputResponses with the associated response.
Validate that client-provided inputResponses is a valid InputResponses object and that the information inside can be correctly parsed.
Return a JSON-RPC error response with an appropriate error code and message for protocol errors (malformed JSON, invalid schema, internal server errors).
Ignore additional, unexpected parameters in InputResponses that it does not recognize or need.

If the client fails to send all requested information and the missing information is necessary, respond with a new InputRequiredResult requesting the missing information again rather than returning an error.
Include resultType in every result ("complete" for ordinary results, "input_required" for MRTR interim results).
requirements.cite: schema.ts L229-234; changelog item 8; basic__index.md L81-84

requirements.text: Treat an absent resultType from an earlier-protocol server as "complete"; treat any unrecognized resultType value as invalid.
requirements.cite: basic__index.md L86-87; schema.ts L230-232; changelog item 8

requirements.text: Cache results produced by retrying through MRTR (requests carrying inputResponses or requestState); interim input_required results are not cacheable and carry no caching hints.
Write JSON-RPC requests to stdout (stdio) or send independent JSON-RPC requests on any HTTP response stream; server-to-client interactions are embedded as inputRequests inside an InputRequiredResult.

Return MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError (-32021, data.requiredCapabilities, HTTP 400) when processing a request requires a capability the client did not include in io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities.
For URL-mode elicitation under MRTR, provide manual controls letting the user retry or cancel the original request, since the out-of-band outcome is learned only by retrying.
Handle cases where the user declines or cancels an elicitation, or where the client fails to process the request.
Check for the roots capability before embedding roots/list.
Skip replaying the original request with an error when a sampling or roots input request fails or is declined; the server is not waiting for a response.

wire_details: resultType constant: "input_required" (InputRequiredResult) vs "complete" (ordinary results); ResultType TS type is "complete" | "input_required" | string (schema.ts L216).

JSON field names: result.inputRequests (object map), result.requestState (string), params.inputResponses (object map), params.requestState (string). No other MRTR fields exist in the material (e.g. no 'round', 'attempt', 'maxRounds', 'inputRequestId').

Embedded request object shape inside inputRequests: {"method": "elicitation/create" | "sampling/createMessage" | "roots/list", "params": {...}} with NO jsonrpc and NO id members (schema.ts InputRequest union L537-538; ElicitRequest L2856, CreateMessageRequest L2185, ListRootsRequest L2718 where params is optional and may contain only _meta).

Embedded response object shape inside inputResponses: bare result objects (ElicitResult {action, content?}; CreateMessageResult {role, content, model, stopReason?}; ListRootsResult {roots}) keyed by the same server-assigned string key; no jsonrpc/id wrapper.
An InputRequiredResult is delivered as a JSON-RPC SUCCESS response ({jsonrpc:"2.0", id, result:{resultType:"input_required", ...}}), never as a JSON-RPC error.

Retry = new JSON-RPC request: same method, new id (MUST differ), original params + inputResponses (+ requestState iff the server sent one). Required _meta keys on every request: io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion, io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities; SHOULD io.modelcontextprotocol/clientInfo. Servers SHOULD put io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo in result._meta (changelog item 2).

Streamable HTTP: each MRTR round is its own POST with Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers (changelog minor 4; streamable-http.md L195-213); server MUST NOT push JSON-RPC requests on SSE response streams (L114). No Mcp-Session-Id, no GET SSE stream, no Last-Event-ID in this revision (L667-673).

Error codes relevant to MRTR handling: -32602 Invalid params (malformed request / missing required field, HTTP 400; basic__index.md L382-384), -32603 Internal error, -32021 MissingRequiredClientCapability (data.requiredCapabilities: ClientCapabilities, HTTP 400), -32022 UnsupportedProtocolVersion, -32020 HeaderMismatch. Removed/forbidden: -32042 URL elicitation required (2025-11-25 only) MUST NOT be emitted (basic__index.md L146). No dedicated error code for requestState verification failure is defined.
Example requestState values in spec: "AEAD-protected blob" (mrtr.md L179), "eyJsb2NhdGlvbiI6Ik5ldyBZb3JrIn0..." (server__tools.md L204/L229) — illustrative only; format is server-defined.
Caching: InputRequiredResult is not a CacheableResult (no ttlMs/cacheScope); retry results MUST NOT be cached (caching.md L25-39).

Tasks extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks) reuses the same maps: tasks/get returns inputRequests when status is input_required; client answers via tasks/update carrying inputResponses (extensions__tasks__overview.md L61-63, L88-89, L238-239) — out of scope here but the map types are shared.
sdk_implications: Types: model Result.resultType as REQUIRED on outgoing server results and tolerant on incoming (absent => "complete"; unknown => invalid/exception). Model InputRequiredResult {inputRequests?, requestState?} with a construction-time invariant that at least one is set (schema.json does not enforce it). Model InputRequests/InputResponses as ordered string-keyed dictionaries; keys unique; values as a discriminated union on `method` (elicitation/create | sampling/createMessage | roots/list) and on the result side by the key's request type.
Client request params for tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get MUST accept optional inputResponses and requestState (InputResponseRequestParams); all other client methods must NOT expose them.

Client SDK: a high-level Invoke-McpTool/Read-McpResource/Get-McpPrompt loop that (1) dispatches each inputRequest to registered handlers (elicitation form/url, sampling, roots) gated by the capabilities the client itself declared, (2) collects results under identical keys, (3) re-issues the original request with a NEW request id, original params, inputResponses, and requestState copied verbatim only if present, (4) never shares inputResponses/requestState with other in-flight requests, (5) offers a configurable max-round guard (spec defines none; Inspector uses a client-side MRTR_MAX_ROUNDS) and user-facing retry/cancel for URL-mode elicitation, (6) handles requestState-only results by immediate retry (optionally with backoff), (7) surfaces decline/cancel to the caller rather than fabricating an error round-trip.
Client SDK MUST reject InputRequiredResult received on methods other than tools/call, resources/read, prompts/get, and MUST treat unrecognized resultType values as invalid.
Client SDK MUST NOT cache results of retries (any request carrying inputResponses/requestState) and must never cache input_required results even for resources/read.

Server SDK: tool/resource/prompt handlers need an API to return 'input required' (e.g. a typed exception or result helper) that takes a keyed set of ElicitRequest/CreateMessageRequest/ListRootsRequest plus optional state; the framework serializes an InputRequiredResult with resultType "input_required" and validates: keys unique, non-empty inputRequests or requestState present, each embedded request type permitted by the caller's declared _meta clientCapabilities (including elicitation form/url mode), otherwise raise MissingRequiredClientCapabilityError (-32021, HTTP 400) or omit the request.

Server SDK: on incoming requests, parse params.inputResponses/params.requestState, expose them to the handler (e.g. context.InputResponses[key] typed as ElicitResult/CreateMessageResult/ListRootsResult), validate shape (return -32602 on malformed), ignore unknown keys, and encourage re-issuing an InputRequiredResult when required responses are missing.

Server SDK: ship a requestState codec with integrity protection (HMAC-SHA256 or AEAD such as AES-GCM via .NET System.Security.Cryptography available in PowerShell 7), embedding principal, TTL/expiry, and a method+params digest; verification failure must reject the request. Provide an opt-out only for state whose tampering merely fails the request. Single-use semantics must be application-provided (server-side store).

Server SDK must NOT expose any API that writes a JSON-RPC request to the client (no server.Elicit/Sample/ListRoots that awaits a response); legacy-era server-request support belongs only to a 2025-xx compatibility layer where the client negotiated an older protocolVersion.
Transport layers: stdio server must never emit requests on stdout; Streamable HTTP server must never emit requests on SSE streams; each retry is an ordinary new POST with Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers.

Multi-turn sampling (agentic loop) and multi-step elicitation must be expressible as successive InputRequiredResults threaded through requestState; provide helpers to serialize accumulated conversation state into requestState and to cap iterations server-side.
Interop with tasks extension: reuse the same InputRequests/InputResponses types for tasks/get and tasks/update if the extension is implemented.
legacy_delta: 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25: servers sent real JSON-RPC requests to the client (ServerRequest union = PingRequest | CreateMessageRequest | ListRootsRequest | ElicitRequest, plus GetTask/GetTaskPayload/ListTasks/CancelTask in 2025-11-25; 2025-06-18_schema.ts L1589-1590, 2025-11-25_schema.ts L2545-2553) with their own ids, and clients replied with JSON-RPC responses (ClientResult included CreateMessageResult/ListRootsResult/ElicitResult). In 2026-07-28 the ServerRequest concept is gone: ClientResult = EmptyResult only and ServerResult gains InputRequiredResult (schema.ts L3169, L3185-3197). A dual-era SDK needs a legacy request-dispatch path (server->client requests over the bidirectional transport) selected by negotiated protocolVersion, and the MRTR path for 2026-07-28.

2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 results have no resultType field; InputRequiredResult, InputRequests, InputResponses, InputResponseRequestParams, inputResponses and requestState do not exist in either legacy schema (grep of both files returns no matches). Clients talking to legacy servers MUST treat absent resultType as "complete".

Legacy embedded request types extended `Request` (so params could carry _meta/progressToken); 2026-07-28 CreateMessageRequest/ElicitRequest/ListRootsRequest are plain {method, params} objects without jsonrpc/id (schema.ts L2185, L2718, L2856); CreateMessageRequestParams does not extend RequestParams (no required _meta).

2025-11-25 introduced URL-mode elicitation with `elicitationId` and `notifications/elicitation/complete` and error -32042 (URL elicitation required); all three are removed in 2026-07-28 (changelog minor item 11; basic__index.md L146). Correlation across retries is now done via requestState.

2025-11-25 transports allowed server requests on SSE streams (Streamable HTTP GET stream, Last-Event-ID resumability, Mcp-Session-Id); all removed in 2026-07-28 (streamable-http.md L667-673). notifications/roots/list_changed removed (changelog item 5). roots and sampling client capabilities are deprecated in 2026-07-28 (SEP-2577, retained >= 12 months) but still usable inside inputRequests.
Streamable HTTP in 2025-03-26..2025-11-25 delivered server requests on SSE; 2026-07-28 embeds them in results per SEP-2322 (streamable-http.md L34-37, L114-121).

Tasks: 2025-11-25 core experimental tasks used tasks/result blocking and server-initiated task-augmented requests; 2026-07-28 moves tasks to extension io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks with tasks/get returning inputRequests and tasks/update carrying inputResponses (changelog item 6).
open_questions: No maximum number of MRTR rounds is specified anywhere in the spec; the Inspector docs mention a client-side MRTR_MAX_ROUNDS (non-normative). The PowerShell client should expose a configurable cap; default value is an SDK design decision.
No size limit for requestState or inputRequests is specified (no byte cap, no header limit). Transport-level limits (HTTP body) apply; SDK may add a configurable guard.

The spec does not define which JSON-RPC error code a server should use when requestState fails integrity/TTL/principal verification; -32602 Invalid params is the closest fit but is not mandated. Also unspecified: whether such failures should be HTTP 400 or 403.

The spec says the client 'retries the original request' but does not state whether the original params (name/arguments/uri) MUST be byte-identical; Server Req 5 recommends servers digest 'salient parameters' and reject mismatches, implying identical params. SDK should resend the exact original params.

Whether an embedded ElicitRequest/CreateMessageRequest params may carry _meta (e.g. progressToken) is not addressed; ListRootsRequest.params?._meta is allowed in the schema, CreateMessageRequestParams has no _meta member. SDK should not require _meta inside embedded requests.

Behaviour when the client cannot fulfil one of several inputRequests (e.g. user cancels one elicitation but answers another): the page only says missing necessary info SHOULD produce another InputRequiredResult; whether the client should still retry with partial inputResponses or abandon is a client policy choice.
Whether a requestState-only (load shedding) result implies any backoff/delay before immediate retry is unspecified (Client Req 1 says MAY retry immediately).
The schema examples referenced by @includeCode (e.g. examples/InputRequiredResult/input-required-result-with-request-state-only.json) are not present locally; contents inferred from names only.
Interaction of MRTR with notifications/progress and progressToken across rounds (each retry is a new request with a new id, so a new progressToken is presumably needed) is not addressed on this page.
